The '''''Envoy''-class shuttle''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was manufactured by [[Tallaani Shipyards]]. ''Envoy''-class shuttles were not meant for warfare, since they lacked heavy shielding or significant armament; nor were they very fast or maneuverable. They were used mostly by merchants or travelers for luxury. ''Envoy''-class shuttles were affordable and had an easy-to-use navigation and autopilot system. During the [[New Sith Wars]], an anonymous benefactor donated the ''Envoy''-class shuttle ''[[Star-Wake]]'' to the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], to assist in the war effort.
